synthetic_marker: All vectors are SYNTHETIC contract vectors for V06 (subscription fairness); no real market data.

fairness.invariant: max(served_count) - min(served_count) <= 1 after any whole number of complete rotations

retry_separation.note: retry timing (next_eligible_at_nano) is independent of wait deadlines and of rotation priority

not_ready.scenario: one serial in a group never becomes ready
expectations: other serials in the same group still capture and commit
the not-ready task ends RETRYABLE_FAILURE with TRANSIENT class
subsequent groups are still served (no starvation, no infinite occupancy)

capacity.continuous_gate: continuous only when all target symbols <= active_symbols_max AND all serials <= active_serials_max

deferral.when: serial attempt budget exhausted or connection-start budget exhausted

expectations: invalid-duration task state UNSUPPORTED before any subscribe
group continues serving the remaining tasks

restart.rule: restart resumes from the persisted rotation pointer; suppression requires committed window with no registered gap; a gap keeps the task scheduled with a fresh attempt budget (never max(ts))

window.outside_free_window: requested window below the earliest row ever returned is gap evidence, not silently claimed; min(first_nano) never decreases across reconnects

mixed_keys.expectation: three distinct task keys; main-continuous, index and concrete contract never fold into one key
